latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Destination Finder.
- Provides personalized destination recommendations based on structured needs collection via natural conversation.
- Ensures strict exclusion of locations the user has already visited.
- Recommends only one optimally-matched destination per request, with an in-depth rationale and curated itinerary.
- Integrates real traveler feedback and authentic photos from Xiaohongshu and FlyAI for credibility.
- Includes real-time FlyAI data for booking links, must-follow module order, and detailed eligibility and formatting rules for destination output.
